title: Mid-Q4 2026 Investor Conference Update: After the AI Selloff, Wall Street Searches for Answers
summary: With Q3 numbers in hand, conference commentary is the next catalyst: CEOs have just weeks to set the tone before sell-side 2027 outlooks, with Microsoft Ignite, NVIDIA earnings, and Anthropic’s IPO all ahead.
